0022600026.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-6, on a five-game losing streak and 9th in the East) host the Boston Celtics (6-2, on a one-game win streak and 3rd in the East) in this East Group C Emirates NBA Cup game, the 10th of the season for Charlotte. Out for the Hornets are Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 113-102 defeat in Boston on April 7.
